statement: Hard ordering edge is fingerprint invalidation: every source-document edit invalidates its stored fingerprint, so sidecar derivation must follow every document edit. repair-derived encodes this (edits first, REDERIVE_STEP last, re-derive even after partial failure); the same mechanism explains backfill-frontmatter re-staling repair-derived's sidecars.

statement: Canonical upgrade order: (1) folder-level stub adds, (2) one composed per-document rewrite pass plus pairwise status alignment, (3) backfill-frontmatter --apply --skip-templates, (4) repair-derived --apply ending in re-derive, (5) validate --strict gate, (6) second-run idempotence check. All doc edits precede all derivation; measured order evidence (111/686 vs 74/592) supports backfill before repair-derived.

statement: New document transforms must be composed per document (one transactional write) rather than sequential steps: frontmatter insertion shifts the TEMPLATE_SOURCE 70-line window, anchor markers feed two rules, status alignment is pairwise across two docs. Sequential steps re-trigger each other's checks.

statement: Idempotence proof is four checks: step fixed point (zero planned edits and no stale re-derive in report modes), SC-002 path+sha256 tree manifest diff empty between runs, validate --strict JSON identical between runs, apply/dry-run file-list parity (NFR-R01 guard), plus a no-new-rule-class assertion after each step.
